messages:
Maria (CS): quick heads-up — Orbis flagged audit logs not appearing in their SIEM after we flipped to private ingestion. they explicitly called out compliance gating renewal on 2026-05-10 :grimacing:
Raj (Networking): looking. initial guess: their collector role can't PUT to the S3 bucket because the VPC endpoint policy is too restrictive. can you confirm which endpoint type they used (gw vs interface)?
Maria (CS): they used interface endpoints (ap-southeast-1), same account. customer says collector uses cross-account role in our staging account to push.
Raj (Networking): ah cross-account + interface endpoint — common gotcha. i'll propose a minimal bucket policy. paste if you want to test:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Orbis-Collector"},
      "Action": "s3:PutObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::orbis-audit-logs/*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abc1234"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Katherine (SecOps): also confirm the KMS key policy — CloudTrail needs kms:Encrypt permissions for the collector principal and the CloudTrail service principal. if the key denies cross-account, logs fail silently. sample snippet:
```
"Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Orbis-Collector"},
"Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
"Effect": "Allow",
"Resource": "*"
```
Ethan (Oncall): i'll run a simulated push from staging account and tail the s3 access logs. will post results here in ~30m.
jira-bot: Created ticket ORB-4123: "Orbis audit-log ingestion failing — cross-account s3/kms policy" and linked to playbook /playbooks/private-audit-ingest.
Maria (CS): thanks — raising risk to medium-high on the account health dashboard until we close ORB-4123. customer asked for an enablement session for their auditors next week. can we do Wed 11am PT?
Raj (Networking): 11am PT works for me.
Katherine (SecOps): works for me, i'll prepare checklist: key policy, rotation, CMKs in each account, bucket lifecycle/retention. linking internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-retention (will drop highlights in the meeting).
Ethan (Oncall): test started: attempting PUT -> 403. will capture aws request-id and paste logs.
Maria (CS): good — i've scheduled the enablement session and invited Orbis primary and their auditor. agenda: quick runthrough of KMS policy, S3 endpoint policy, validation scripts, and post-meeting checklist.
Raj (Networking): after session i'll send a one-click policy patch they can apply and roll back.
Maria (CS): action items: Raj — draft bucket + endpoint policy; Katherine — finalize KMS snippet and retention recs; Ethan — finish test and attach logs to ORB-4123. i'll update the account health note and follow up on renewal risk if not resolved by 2026-05-03. :eyes:
Katherine (SecOps): noted. i'll also recommend enabling CloudTrail integrity checks while we're here.
Ethan (Oncall): attaching current failure log excerpt in ticket.
Maria (CS): thanks team, i'll keep Orbis updated and capture feedback after the enablement call for our product notes."
